facts.value: Confirm your place in ASU’s incoming class by submitting your enrollment deposit via My ASU.
To review your transfer credits, visit the ASU Transfer Guide, log in with your ASURITE User ID and password, and click on My Transfer Guide.
In the Transfer Student Orientation, you will prepare for your first semester by completing essential next steps for enrollment.
You must pay your enrollment deposit and meet with an academic advisor before you can register for classes.
The 2026-2027 Free Application for Federal Student Aid is available now. ASU’s Federal School Code is 001081.
Transfer scholarships are available to help pay for tuition, housing, books, and other costs when you transfer to ASU.
You must submit your measles (rubeola), mumps, and rubella immunization form before classes begin.
